📦 **ArtGallery `2b0f683`** — art: exhibit The Tidal Archive and Where Morning Comes to Moor

Create two original 1536x1024 fantasy paintings for Tim's open-ended gallery request. Exhibit them in Diary with separate authored curatorial cards linking the night-to-morning pair. Preserve the exact built-in image_gen prompts, source paths, dimensions and SHA-256; PNGs are copied byte-for-byte without post-editing.

Validation: visually inspected both generated paintings; gallery build and --check pass, with two new Diary exhibits and no missing-image warnings. Browser gallery UI preview remains unverified because the earlier local-file browser access was blocked. gallery_data.js is generated and ignored. Commit only this ArtGallery layer; no parent pointer bump or push.

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---
